framework: review-specific mixed-method risk-of-bias and applicability appraisal

dimensions.name: internal validity
dimensions.rationale: Participant-level random assignment, blinded response coding, covariate checks, and multiplicity adjustment support causal comparisons; relevance and elaboration probes were bundled.

dimensions.name: measurement validity
dimensions.rationale: Multiple quality measures and human coders are strengths, but respondent confirmations are vulnerable to acquiescence and several text metrics are indirect proxies for information quality.

dimensions.name: external validity
dimensions.rationale: A quota-sampled proprietary non-probability U.S. panel and one 2024 platform/model limit generalization.

applicability: Directly applicable to LLM-assisted web survey interviewing; less direct for long-form qualitative or clinical interviews.
